gloss: person who gives up easily; quitter

definitions.gloss: person who gives up easily; quitter; short-lived enthusiasm
definitions.explanation: Someone who starts things but quickly loses interest and gives up. Also refers to short-lived efforts or hobbies.

examples.english: My diets always end after three days.

examples.english: I'm a quitter, so I can't stick with things.

examples.english: I think it's important to keep at it even a little every day so you don't give up too quickly.

notes:
Literally "three-day monk" - referring to someone who becomes a monk but gives up after just three days.

ETYMOLOGY:
Monastic life is difficult, and those without true dedication would quit after only a few days, hence "three-day monk."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {三日坊主|みっかぼうず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧: to end after only a few days
- {三日坊主|みっかぼうず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a quitter

USAGE:
Often used self-deprecatingly when one admits to lacking perseverance.
